:::{#exr-prob-positive}
#### Probability of a positive test

Derive an expression for the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $\Pr(\posclass)$ that a diagnostic test is [positive](#def-positive-classification)
in terms of:

- the test's [sensitivity](#def-sensitivity);
- the test's [specificity](#def-specificity);
- the [prevalence](#def-prevalence) of the disease.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-prob-positive}

By the
[law of total probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#thm-total-prob)
over the partition $\set{D, \neg D}$,
the [complement rule](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#cor-p-neg0),
and @thm-negative-classification-complement:

$$
\ba
\Pr(\posclass)
&= \Pr(\posclass \mid D) \cd \Pr(D) + \Pr(\posclass \mid \neg D) \cd \Pr(\neg D)
&& \text{(law of total probability)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \Pr(D) + \Pr(\posclass \mid \neg D) \cd \Pr(\neg D)
&& \text{(definition of sensitivity)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence} + \Pr(\posclass \mid \neg D) \cd \Pr(\neg D)
&& \text{(definition of prevalence)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence} + \paren{1 - \Pr(\neg \posclass \mid \neg D)} \cd \Pr(\neg D)
&& \text{(complement rule, conditional on } \neg D \text{)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence} + \paren{1 - \Pr(\negclass \mid \neg D)} \cd \Pr(\neg D)
&& \text{(negative classification is the complement of positive)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence} + \paren{1 - \text{specificity}} \cd \Pr(\neg D)
&& \text{(definition of specificity)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence} + \paren{1 - \text{specificity}} \cd \paren{1 - \Pr(D)}
&& \text{(complement rule)} \\
&= \text{sensitivity} \cd \text{prevalence} + \paren{1 - \text{specificity}} \cd \paren{1 - \text{prevalence}}
&& \text{(definition of prevalence)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-prob-positive-exr}

:::
